## Description

Combines fractional Brownian motion variance ratio tests with machine learning trend-scanning algorithms to detect statistically significant directional trends across multiple time horizons.

## Where it may fit

Multi-horizon trend following, persistent directional regimes in equity indices and commodities.

## Vehicles

Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), Systematic Trend Following Funds.

## Required data

High-frequency and daily OHLCV bar data, fractional differencing parameters.

## Caveats

Trend-scanning lookback windows must be carefully calibrated to avoid look-ahead bias.
